analysis: The prefix-only supervision trial completed successfully but did not improve validation HR@10: authoritative host macro HR@10 was 0.4412, versus 0.4462 for the prior model and 0.5050 for the cited SASRec baseline. Category HR@10 was Movies_and_TV 0.425, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.495, Electronics 0.365, and CDs_and_Vinyl 0.480. Earlier category scores were not supplied, so category-level changes cannot be established. The result does not support prefix-only sampling as an improvement under the retained configuration; it does not establish why performance declined. Deterministic sampler checks passed, including prefix boundaries, retained repeated items, nonempty contexts, negative exclusion, and output shapes. The trial consumed 398.12 allocated GPU-seconds.
code_summary: Retained the per-category AttentiveSimilarity architecture: separate 96-dimensional context and target embeddings, 32-dimensional candidate-conditioned attention, bounded exponential attention with square-root normalization, candidate biases, and 0.1 context dropout. Changed training examples to sample a target after the first interaction and use only its preceding prefix, retaining earlier occurrences of that target. Preserved mixed recent-window/ordered-subsample truncation, 15% context dropout, right-aligned padding, and 64 uniform negatives excluded against the complete training history, with duplicates permitted. Optimization, checkpoint selection, all four dataset routes, predictor writer, and inference behavior remained unchanged.
